set.body:
Objective
Record the decisions every later packet relies on, so implementation never re-litigates them.

Authority and inputs
Plan: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity.md (Phase 0, D0, Scope). Reader map: docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md. References: ~/code/neurotransform (kernel/format parity), ~/code/neurofunctor (graph/operator parity). R packages are references, not APIs to copy.

Owner role and starting seams
architecture; docs/decisions/spatial-transforms.md. Bounded candidates, not reservations; reserve exact paths when beginning.

Prerequisite packets
Native mote blocking edges are authoritative; see docs/plans/spatial-transform-parity-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. image4s-geometry stays the Frame/Point/Vec authority for this epic; spatial4s migration is a separate upstream effort (or the user's explicit alternative is recorded).
2. Names WorldTransform, WorldSpace, FrameCatalog, Placed collision-checked against modules/ and provider packages; rationale for not using 'Registration' (reframe4s RegistrationResult).
3. Hemisphere: unify surface (Left/Right/Both/Unknown) and atlas (Left/Right/Bilateral/Midline) or document why both exist.
4. Owners decided for barycentric closest-face kernel / sphere helpers (surface vs mesh provider) and overlap metrics (locus4s).
5. Out-of-scope list confirmed: ITK BSpline, AFNI BRIK/HEAD, FreeSurfer .m3z, motion-parameter files, elastix — each rejected with a typed error.
6. FreeSurfer license handling for oracle generation (generator machine only, never repo/CI) and neurotransform MIT fixture reuse recorded.

Verification
Review ADR against the plan and current sources; user sign-off on the open decisions recorded as a mote note.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet plus its owner-local tests/docs. Respect the authority ledger (docs/plans/image-module-unification-hardening.md) and the imageAlgebraBoundaryCheck forbidden names (no SpatialMorphism/Affine3DMorphism/IdentityMorphism/DenseFieldInverse/JacobianField/JacobianMode etc.). Generic transform/warp math belongs in reframe4s, geometry in image4s, linear algebra in Gale; ScalaFIM keeps neuroimaging policy and adapters. Every change compiles and passes on JVM and JS, run in bounded sbt batches (never scalafimTestAll in one shot); keep scalafimCompileAll warning-clean. Stage with explicit pathspecs (concurrent writers share this worktree). No push, release or foreign-store mutation. At handoff attach exact revisions, commands and results, oracle manifest hashes and declared caveats; unresolved criteria keep the packet open.
set.title: STP-P0.01: ADR: frame authority, naming, Hemisphere, kernel owners, scope and oracle licensing
